name: skrun-runner
description: In-machine RPC server of the skrun-runtime image. Not a pnpm workspace member: the image installs it with npm ci from package-lock.json, which pins every package to the version pnpm-lock.yaml resolved. The dependencies listed here are the runner's own plus the production dependencies of @skrun-dev/schema and @skrun-dev/runtime, whose tarballs the image extracts into node_modules at build time. Regenerate the lock with infra/runtime-image/update-locks.sh.
